name: Grade-Only Subjects Out of 50 and Grade Scale
releaseNote: Std 10 Swasthya and Sharirik Shikshan and Std 11 Computer Adhyayan grade-only subjects accept marks out of 50 and convert them to the requested A1–E2 grading scale.
notes: Grade-only marks remain excluded from total, percentage, pass/fail, and class rank. No student data, marks, exam records, or Supabase schema changed.
